payload.prompt: A narrow canyon between two high walls of rock, seen in a first-person view at standing eye height. On the left, the walls are made of orange stone marked with flowing, undulating waves of rock, like frozen rivers. On the right, the canyon continues down and out of the picture, its bed of cobbles smothered under a thick layer of dark wet mud. The floor of the canyon slopes down from the left of the picture to the right. The floor is a rough slope of cracked rock broken into low ledges. A pool of warm lamplight falls on the canyon floor, brightest in the centre of the picture, with the tops of the rock walls in darkness. The picture fills the whole frame, edge to edge. Setting: a medieval fantasy world; everything is old and handmade: weathered stone and old brick, rough timber, wrought iron. Style: 1970s comic book art: bold black ink outlines, hand-inked hatching, flat printed colours with visible halftone dots, slightly off-register colour printing, muted earthy palette of browns, ochres, olive and amber, on aged newsprint. Mood: quiet, still and mysterious, a place long left alone.

routes.why: The prompt asks for the canyon to continue down and out of the picture on the right, but the image shows it continuing straight ahead into darkness.
routes.fix: Change the composition so the canyon floor and walls on the right slope downwards and lead out of the frame to the right, rather than straight ahead.

routes.why: The prompt clearly asks for cobbles smothered under a thick layer of dark wet mud on the right, but the image shows dry stones.
routes.fix: Cover the cobbles on the right with a thick layer of dark, glistening wet mud.

routes.why: The prompt asks for the floor to slope down from left to right, but the image shows a floor that primarily leads straight ahead with minimal lateral slope.
routes.fix: Redraw the floor as a clear slope that drops from the left side of the image down towards the right.
